CODE: CONTENT

🍇 FOOD FIGHT: Fire grape bursts, launch pizza slices, and throw cupcakes!

💥 FEED & DEFEAT: Fill enemies up until they grow huge and explode!

🥖 BUILD YOUR LOADOUT: Mix foods and abilities to find your winning combo!

🏆 WIN ROUNDS: Rack up kills, build streaks, and take the victory!
|
🎯 PRACTICE: Test your aim in the shooting range!

🎁 UNLOCK REWARDS: Level up and collect new rewards!

💻 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
🧪 Currently in BETA — more foods and updates coming!
👍 Don’t forget to like & favourite!
👥 Invite your friends and join the food fight!
